content.value: Write down the pseudo-code for electricity charge caleulation where input is electricity unit (10) charges and caleulates total electricity bill according to the following conditions: For first 50 units, Tk 2.00/unit For next 100 units, Tk 2.50/unit For next 100 units, 'Tk 3.00/unit For above 250 units, 'Tk 4.00/unit
